persona_summary: Elena prefers calm, accessible Harbor UI screens with explicit labels instead of icon-only controls. Dense internal diagnostics may use compact tables. She later revokes the earlier preference for decorative gradients.
scenario: Suggest controls for a customer-facing Harbor UI settings page.

alternatives.content: - Use explicit text labels for important controls instead of icon-only actions.
A standing harbor-ui preference is established.
- Use explicit text labels for important controls instead of icon-only actions.
In harbor-ui, give important controls explicit text labels rather than using icon-only actions.
